items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He conducted the band and he was the handsome cat and all the women was after him like that was after Cab and them kind of thing.

ctx.x: But he, he didn‘t do, but he was like Cab Calloway in other words. He conducted the band and he was the handsome cat and all the women was after him like that was after Cab and them kind of thing.
So, Chick Carter band, how big was the band?
